name: Anka India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Anka India Limited is in the business of Information Technology.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
The company provides IT solutions in the fields of Data Analytics and Business Intelligence, Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions, and Custom Application Development and Maintenance Services to Government, mid-market, and fast-growing clients. With  OEMs and other SI partners, the company has developed and delivered IT solutions and services to financial, retail, telecom, media, pharma, healthcare, and government organizations.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.12 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.90% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.6%
